topic: A lonely sock that lost its pair in the wash.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Lonely Sock

shots.narration: I went into the wash married. I came out single.
shots.scene: Cosy modern laundry room, open washing machine, vertical 9:16 frame, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text.
shots.action: A blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small shocked mouth tumbles alone from the washer onto the floor.
shots.mood: Bright pastel colours, dramatic empty space around the tiny sock.

shots.narration: Naturally, I checked our last known address.
shots.scene: Inside an empty washing machine drum, vertical 9:16 frame, soft reflected laundry-room light, no visible text.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small worried mouth peers into the empty drum.
shots.mood: Cool silver reflections, comically cavernous emptiness.

shots.narration: [sighs] Nothing. Just that coin nobody ever claims.
shots.scene: Bottom of an empty washing machine drum with one plain coin, vertical 9:16 frame, no visible text.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small disappointed mouth nudges the coin with its toe.
shots.mood: Soft blue lighting, tiny lonely treasure.

shots.narration: Maybe my partner was hiding in the clean laundry.
shots.scene: White laundry basket filled with colourful unmarked clothes, cosy laundry room, vertical 9:16 frame.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small determined mouth dives into the laundry pile.
shots.mood: Warm light, colourful fabric mountains, hopeful energy.

shots.narration: Nope. Just a fitted sheet swallowing everyone else's belongings.
shots.scene: Laundry basket with a pale fitted sheet spread across the top, vertical 9:16 frame, no visible text.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small strained mouth wriggles out of an elastic sheet corner.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] The missing-sock drawer. Very comforting name for a retirement home.
shots.scene: Open wooden bedroom drawer containing several unmatched socks, vertical 9:16 frame, no visible text.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small dejected mouth slumps into an empty corner.
shots.mood: Warm bedroom light, lonely gap among colourful socks.

shots.narration: Then someone else showed up without a plus-one.
shots.scene: Same open wooden drawer, blue sock beside an empty space, vertical 9:16 frame, no visible text.
shots.action: A pink striped sock drops beside the blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small surprised mouth.
shots.mood: Bright pink accent, sudden hopeful warmth.

shots.narration: Different colours. Same abandonment issues. Honestly, we clicked.
shots.scene: Open bedroom drawer with blue and pink striped socks side by side, vertical 9:16 frame, no visible text.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small delighted mouth curls its toe around the pink sock's toe.
shots.mood: Cosy golden lighting, sweetly ridiculous romance.

shots.narration: [chuckles] I found love again. The dryer still needs a lawyer.
shots.scene: Laundry counter beside a closed unmarked dryer, pink striped sock beside the blue sock, vertical 9:16 frame.
shots.action: The blue sock with big cartoon eyes and a small suspicious mouth points its toe accusingly at the dryer.
shots.mood: Bright domestic courtroom drama, dryer looming in the background.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the dryer finally tells its side of the story.
episode.description: One wash cycle, one missing soulmate, and one very suspicious dryer. A lonely sock discovers that moving on doesn't always mean matching.
